item_short_desc: Rothco’s U.S. Navy 2-Cell Flight Deck/Traffic Wand is a reliable signaling tool designed for optimal visibility in various conditions. Made in the USA, this lightweight wand features a sealed plastic handle for waterproof operation, ensuring functionality even in rainy weather. Equipped with 6 color filters—red, amber, green, blue, white, and clear—it offers versatile signaling options for different needs.
description: Rothco’s U.S. Navy 2-Cell Flight Deck/Traffic Wand is a reliable signaling tool designed for optimal visibility in various conditions. Made in the USA, this lightweight wand features a sealed plastic handle for waterproof operation, ensuring functionality even in rainy weather. Equipped with 6 color filters—red, amber, green, blue, white, and clear—it offers versatile signaling options for different needs. The powerful light beam can be seen from up to a half mile away, making it perfect for directing traffic, signaling on flight decks, or ensuring visibility in low-light environments. With a runtime of up to 5 hours of continuous light, this wand is a dependable choice for nighttime operations.
